name: Ecoplast Limited
about: Ecoplast Limited, together with its subsidiary, Synergy Films Private Limited, manufactures, processes, and sells co-extruded plastic films for packaging and industrial applications in India and internationally. The company offers lamination and surface protection films, multilayer coextruded polyethylene, co-polymer, surface protection, speciality application, adhesive, glueless co-ex surface protection, sustainable polyethylene, and lamination films. The company also provides quality management, research and development, technical support, and custom print image services. The company serves various industries, such as construction and building materials, medicine and pharmaceuticals, automotive, food and beverage, industrial applications, agriculture, hygiene, and cosmetics. It also exports its products. Ecoplast Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
